name: Nullsafe
description:
A nullsafe operator is able to carry a function or fail graciously to ``null``. In particular, it won't stop the execution with a fatal error. 

There are two PHP operators that are nullsafe: 

+ Nullsafe object operator ``?->``
+ Nullsafe-coalesce ``??``.
code:
<?php

    $a = trumpet();

    $b = $a?->method();

    $b = $a?->chain1?->chain2?->method();

    // trumpet may return null
    function trumpet() : ?Elephpant { }

?>

citations.name: Mastering Null Safety in PHP 8: A Comprehensive Guide to Using the Null Safe Operator
